title.zh: Ethena 就币安敞口与 ENA 存入作出说明
title.en: Ethena addresses Binance exposure and ENA deposit

current_state.zh: Ethena 向 Binance 存入 1.286 亿枚 ENA（约 2433 万美元），显然是为配合 Binance 回购其在漏洞事件中被盗的 2.175 亿枚 ENA，以便完成储备证明。
current_state.en: Ethena deposited 128.6 million ENA (about $24.33 million) to Binance, apparently as part of Binance's buyback of the 217.5 million ENA stolen in its breach so it can complete Proof of Reserves.

updates.title_zh: 【Ethena：对币安未实现盈亏敞口约 880 万美元，远低于储备基金】
updates.title_en: 【Ethena：对币安未实现盈亏敞口约 880 万美元，远低于储备基金】
updates.what_changed_zh: Ethena 表示，其对 Binance 的未实现盈亏敞口总计约 880 万美元，远低于其超过 6000 万美元的超额储备基金；抵押品存放于交易所外托管机构，第三方储备证明将在数小时内出具。此前链上有报告称 Binance 热钱包疑似遭攻击。
updates.what_changed_en: Ethena said its unrealized PnL exposure to Binance totals about $8.8 million — far below its over $60 million excess reserve fund — with collateral held at off-exchange custodians and third-party proof of reserves due within hours, amid on-chain reports of a suspected Binance hot wallet attack.
